description_en: Queries the list of deleted clusters by calling DescribeDeletedClusters
description_zh: 调用DescribeDeletedClusters查询已删除的集群列表
name: DescribeDeletedClusters

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of rows per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 集群创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

DataCenterCount.description_en: The number of data centers in the cluster

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the cluster. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群到期时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

MajorVersion.description_en: The major version number of the cluster

MinorVersion.description_en: The minor version number of the cluster

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型，可取值：

Subscription：包年包月
PayAsYouGo：按量付费

按量付费实例无到期时间

Status.description_en:
The cluster status. Example valid values:

Creating: being created.
CreateFailed: creation failed.
Running: running.
Deleting: being deleted.
DeleteFailed: deletion failed.
Deleted: deleted
Status.description_zh:
集群运行状态，可取值部分示例：

Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中
DeleteFailed：删除失败
Deleted：已删除

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. Valid values: greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of cluster records returned by the query
